item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President delegates an existing presidential function to agency heads; the segment does not itself void or rescind any transaction or require a particular later outcome.","evidence":"is hereby delegated the authority vested in the President to declare void and rescind the transactions"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads are permissively authorized to implement the delegated authority through regulations, without a mandated substantive result.","evidence":"may exercise the authority hereby delegated by promulgating implementing regulations"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The named administrators must later issue government-wide regulations containing specified, binding procedural protections for affected persons or entities.","evidence":"shall issue government-wide implementing regulations related to voiding or rescission of contracts"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The agency head or designee must issue a later decision, but the segment does not dictate the remedy or amount that decision must impose.","evidence":"shall issue a final written decision specifying the amount of restitution or any other remedy"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"This directs a factor that agency decision-makers must consider when determining a remedy, without prescribing the legal outcome.","evidence":"shall take into consideration the fair value of any tangible benefits received and retained by the agency"}]}
